subject: 英语
source: 人教版(PEP)小学英语（三年级起点，3-6年级）语法与功能句型体系
original_text: 频度副词：always 总是, usually 通常, often 经常, sometimes 有时, never 从不。句型：I usually get up at 7:00. What do you do on the weekend? — I often clean my room. 频度副词放实义动词前、be 动词/助动词后。
formulas: 示例：I usually get up at 7. / He often plays football.
cautions: ①频度副词位置错（应放实义动词前）；②周末用 on the weekend（勿漏 on）；③usually/often 拼写错；④What do you do... 与 What are you doing...（进行时）混淆。
